Hi team —

Can the SE team confirm availability next week for a 60–90 minute working session? My asks:
- Include one customer engineer (Alex) + one procurement contact (they cc'd procurement).
- SE to bring an engineer who can demo routing and a short run-of-show (ideally 60–75 minutes).
- Prep doc and pre-demo questions attached for VelociSys to fill out.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 2025-07-23: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2025-07-24: 08:30–10:00 or 11:00–12:30

@Lukas / @Karthik can you confirm which of the above you can cover? I can lead the AE intro and own next steps.

Thanks,

Thanks Vanessa — I can cover the demo on the serving/runtime side. A few quick items from our side before we book time:

1) We prefer 75 minutes to allow a short hands-on segment and Q&A.
2) Could Alex confirm which of the following two slots works on your side (I converted to PT):
   - Thu 2025-07-24 11:00–12:15 PT (14:00–15:15 ET)
   - Wed 2025-07-23 14:00–15:15 PT (17:00–18:15 ET)
3) What systems would you like us to access/see? (e.g., sample traces, a staging dataset, or SSO-protected console). If SSO or VPN is required, we need a contact to provision short-term access.
4) I've attached a short pre-demo questionnaire (velocisys-pre-demo-questions.xlsx) — please have your engineer fill the network/security rows so we can load any necessary hooks ahead of time.

If those slots don't work, propose two alternatives and we'll triage.
